messages:
ash: Observed a ~3x token-serving cost bump during 02:00-03:00 UTC last night. Suspect scale-to-zero churn causing lots of prewarms. Any ideas on tuning idle downscaling? @maria @kai

maria: Saw that too, flagged it in the cost board. Quick question — did we change nodeSelector on the gpu pools last week? If pods land on different node types we lose KV cache reuse.

kai: Yep, that's part of it. Also CA scaleDownDelay + warm pool cooldown are fighting each other. We currently have scaleDownDelay=5m and warmPool.cooldown=2m which can cause churn when load is bursty. :thinking:

tanner: I pulled the start-time heatmap: spikes line up with prewarm completions. When many pods prewarm concurrently we pay a spike. We should either stagger prewarms or increase cooldown so PLs reuse warm nodes.

prashant: Staggering is my vote. Add pacing to the placement controller so we only un-snooze N pods / AZ / minute. That avoids parallel kernel loading and NVLink contention.

ash: Draft helm snippet for discussion:
```yaml
warmPool:
  enabled: true
  minSize: 2
  cooldownSeconds: 600
autoscaler:
  scaleDownDelayAfterAdd: 600s
  maxSurge: 1
```
Thoughts?

maria: Looks reasonable. Two tweaks: make cooldown region-aware (shorter in cheap regions), and set evictionGracePeriod for GPU pods to 120s so drains don't immediately kill warm caches.

kai: Another idea — node-level "snooze" mode instead of full drain. Mark nodes as snoozed to keep ephemeral caches and /tmp alive, only fully drain when forced. That should reduce cold-starts significantly.

tanner: For interruptible (spot) nodes: set warmPool.minSize=1 and push steady traffic to dedicated pools. We don't want to waste prewarms on unstable spot nodes.

prashant: Recommend a small experiment: bump idle threshold for ml-inference namespace from 300s -> 900s, run 24h with metrics (cost, p50/p95 latency, cold-start count). If cost stabilizes and latency OK, promote.

sre-bot: deploy triggered by @ash: gpu-scaling-experiment configmap updated (sha:3f9c). See /deploys/1856789012

kai: I'll own the canary. Rolling out a 10% canary in us-west2 at 03:30 UTC. Will collect token cost, cold-starts, and tail latency.

ash: Awesome — thanks. If we see tail-latency regressions we rollback. Ping me if dashboards show anomalies. :eyes:
